name: Review the findings
description: Gathers what this round's spikes and prototypes found into FINDINGS.md, and lists each prototype's branch for you to try. Its approval is where you accept or reject the prototypes; your feedback is recorded so the next round of research can act on it.

parameters.label: What kind of work this is
parameters.description: How the prompts name the work, e.g. "feature" or "bug fix".

parameters.label: The document the spikes serve
parameters.description: The file in the scratch directory that the spikes and prototypes settle questions for, e.g. SPECS.md (the draft specs) or OPTIONS.md (architecture options).

step.name: Review the findings
step.prompt:
The spikes and prototypes for this {{params.work}} ({{ticket.title}}) have run. Prototype branches were kept unmerged, for a person to try.

Read {{scratch.path}}/SPIKES.md, each spike-*.md and prototype-*.md ticket and its _REPORT.md, {{scratch.path}}/{{params.brief}} (the draft they serve), and FINDINGS.md if an earlier round wrote one (keep what it says). Do not change any files.

{{feedback}}

If the user's feedback above accepts or rejects a prototype, record that and why: a rejected prototype's approach must not be relied on.

Reply with FINDINGS.md, in markdown, and nothing else:

# Findings: {{ticket.title}}
## Spikes
(each spike: its question and the answer, with sources)
## Prototypes
(each prototype: what it tried, what happened, its branch (git branch --list 'afl/*') and how to try it, and whether a person has accepted it: accepted, rejected or waiting)
## What this means for {{params.brief}}
(what holds, what has to change, what is still unknown)
## Still to find out
(questions for another spike or prototype, or none)
